svg.title: Ishikari metro map, readable

g.title: Ishikari metro map: How to read this map. Click for more.
g.text: Read it like a page: each row left to right, then wrap to the next row.

g.title: Row 1: 1 ASK · 2 PLAN Click for more.
Row 2: 3 BUILD · 4 CHECK · 5 FIX · 6 MERGE Click for more.
Row 3: 6 FINISH: JUDGE · MAIN MOVES Click for more.
Plan line: Rows 1 to 2: from your task to the worker plans. Click for more.
Question line: The investigator asks you, you answer. Click for more.
Research line: The investigator sends researcher ants. Click for more.
Build line: Rows 2 to 3: build, check, merge, judge, finish. Click for more.
Fix loop: A bug goes back to the worker and is re-checked. Click for more.
Clash line: Tasks that break together go back to the fix loop. Click for more.
Dropped spur: A task that could not be fixed leaves here. Click for more.
Merge failed spur: A failed merge goes back to the worker ants. Click for more.
Cleanup failed spur: A failed cleanup becomes a suggested next task. Click for more.
Judge fix loop: Below 7 with gaps: one fix round. Click for more.
After main moves: Green: the run's work is on main. Click for more.
Check failed spur: A failed app check starts one new task. Click for more.
Row wrap: to row 2 Click for more.
Merge failed spur: merge failed: to Worker ants, row 2 Click for more.
g.text: merge failed: to Worker ants, row 2

g.title: Junction: Where the dropped spur leaves the line. Click for more.
Dropped spur: dropped Click for more.
Cleanup failed spur: cleanup failed: to Task, row 1 (next run) Click for more.
g.text: cleanup failed: to Task, row 1 (next run)

g.title: Check failed spur: check failed: to Worker ants, row 2 (new task) Click for more.
g.text: check failed: to Worker ants, row 2 (new task)

g.title: Junction: Where the judge fix loop rejoins the line. Click for more.
Row wrap: to row 3 Click for more.
Task (r1s1): The work you hand Ishikari. Click for more.
Investigator ant (r1s2): Asks you questions, then writes the investigation report. Click for more.
You (r1s4): You answer the investigator's questions. Click for more.
Researcher ants (r1s3): Look up facts for the investigator. Click for more.
investigation_report.md (r1s5): Everything learned while planning, written once. Click for more.
Add requirement ant (r1s6): Drafts the requirement entry; skipped with no requirements file. Click for more.
Architect ant (r1s8): Writes architecture.md and one plan per task. Click for more.
Worker plans (r1s9): One complete plan per task. Click for more.
Logbook (r1s7): Every ant's reply, one entry each. Click for more.
Worker ants (r2s1): Build the plans, one worktree each. Click for more.
Detective ants (r2s2): Check each built task and plan every fix. Click for more.
Integrator ant (r2s3): Merges all passing tasks in a scratch copy and tests once. Click for more.
Merger ant (r2s4): Merges the approved tasks for real, then checks with git; failures go back to the workers. Click for more.
Janitor ant (r2s5): Cleans up mess the run left, by itself. Click for more.
Juror ants (r3s1): Score each merged task against its plan. Click for more.
Judge ant (r3s2): Scores the whole run 0-10 against the plans. Click for more.
Worker ant (r3s3): Closes the judge's gaps. Click for more.
Detective ant (r3s4): Checks the judge fix. Click for more.
Merger ant (r3s5): Lands the judge fix by fast-forward. Click for more.
Judge ant (r3s6): Scores again after the fix. Click for more.
Finisher ant (r3s7): Moves main, cleans up, runs the check. Click for more.
MAIN (r3s8): Your main branch, moved forward. Click for more.
checkCommand (r3s9): Builds and checks the app after main moves. Click for more.
req done (r3s10): Marks this run's requirements DONE. Click for more.
Car 1: A sample task riding the plan line. Click for more.
Car 2: A sample task riding the build line. Click for more.
Car 3: A sample task riding the build line. Click for more.
Car 4: A sample task riding the build line. Click for more.
Car 5: A sample task riding the build line. Click for more.
Car 6: A sample task riding the build line. Click for more.
Car 7: A sample task riding the fix loop. Click for more.
Car 8: A sample task riding the fix loop. Click for more.
Car 10: A sample task riding the after main moves. Click for more.
Car 11: A sample task riding the judge fix loop. Click for more.
Moving dot: Shows a round of questions. Click for more.
Moving dot: Shows a burst of research. Click for more.
Key: What the cars, symbols and colours mean. Click for more.
g.text: a bug through the fix loop

Only one round."},{"y":200,"sub":["you give it, or a","dropped cleanup plan"],"name":"Task","tip":"The work you hand Ishikari.","src":"SKILL.md#1-setup","id":"task","code":"r1s1","x":120,"about":"Your task in your own words, or the note of a cleanup the last run dropped. Setup makes the run's state folder and env first; the main checkout must be on the main branch with no uncommitted changes."},{"y":200,"sub":["one live agent run by the skill: reads","the repo once, gets each answer as a message;","no Agent tool: the plan workflow runs it"],"name":"Investigator ant","tip":"Asks you questions, then writes the investigation report.","src":"assets/prompts/investigator.md, SKILL.md#2a-live-investigator","id":"investigator","code":"r1s2","x":440,"about":"One live agent run by the skill, not a workflow: it reads the repo once and gets each answer as a message. It critiques the task, finds the test command, and asks up to 4 independent questions at a time, about 8 in all. It stops once nothing important is unclear. Without the Agent tool the plan workflow runs it instead."},{"y":90,"sub":["up to 4 questions a round (/ask-simple),","8 in all; answering approves the whole run"],"name":"You","tip":"You answer the investigator's questions.","src":"SKILL.md#2a-live-investigator","id":"you","code":"r1s4","x":440,"about":"The only time Ishikari asks you anything. Questions come through /ask-simple, up to 4 at a time, about 8 in all. Answering approves the whole run, merge to main included."},{"y":290,"sub":["up to 5 at once, web + computer,","read only; the investigator waits"],"name":"Researcher ants","tip":"Look up facts for the investigator.","src":"SKILL.md#limits","id":"researchers","code":"r1s3","x":440,"about":"Up to 5 at once, 2 bursts per question. They search the web and the whole computer, read only, never secrets, and report back. The investigator waits for them. Not logged when the live investigator sends them."},{"y":200,"sub":["written when nothing is unclear;","the investigator is stopped"],"name":"investigation_report.md","tip":"Everything learned while planning, written once.","src":"<state>/plans/<run>/investigation_report.md","id":"report","code":"r1s5","x":780,"about":"Goal, scope, every decision you made, facts with sources, constraints, risks, assumptions, acceptance checks and commands. Every claim cites an answer, a fact or the repo. Later ants read it instead of asking you. The main session never edits it."},{"y":200,"sub":["drafts the requirement entry;","the main session pipes it into ishikari.py req add;","no requirements file: no add requirement ant"],"name":"Add requirement ant","tip":"Drafts the requirement entry; skipped with no requirements file.","src":"scripts/ishikari-plan.js (Requirement phase)","id":"add-requirement","code":"r1s6","x":1100,"about":"Reads only the report and the repo; the report wins. Drafts the entry with /add-requirement and shows it can be built, with a throwaway spike only if needed. Never asks, designs or plans. The main session pipes the entry into ishikari.py req add. Runs only when setup finds requirements.org or requirements/*.org."},{"y":200,"sub":["writes architecture.md","and one plan per task"],"name":"Architect ant","tip":"Writes architecture.md and one plan per task.","src":"scripts/ishikari-plan.js (Design phase)","id":"architect","code":"r1s8","x":1420,"about":"Designs the parts of the change, the files each owns, and every name, interface and data shape between them, so parallel workers fit. Maps each acceptance check to a part. Splits the work into tasks of about 3 files, no two editing one file, each with its own test file."},{"y":200,"sub":["one per task: title, files, after;","checked before anything is built"],"name":"Worker plans","tip":"One complete plan per task.","src":"<state>/plans/<run>/<task>.md","id":"plans","code":"r1s9","x":1700,"about":"Workers cannot ask questions, so each plan is complete: title, files, after. The plan script rejects bad or unknown ids, loops in after, two tasks on one file, and a bad requirement, before anything is built."},{"y":40,"sub":["logbook clerk ant: appends each ant's entry","the moment the ant replies, one clerk at a time, in plan, build and finish.","The live investigator gets only an investigated entry.","Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it.","~/.ishikari/<repo>-<hash>/logbook.rec"],"name":"Logbook","tip":"Every ant's reply, one entry each.","src":"~/.ishikari/<repo>-<hash>/logbook.rec","id":"logbook","code":"r1s7","x":1370,"about":"A recfile the logbook clerk appends to the moment an ant replies, one clerk at a time. Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it; read it with ishikari.py log status, recsel or an editor."},{"y":440,"sub":["max 5, one worktree each,","code + tests + docs;","stuck: next fix round"],"name":"Worker ants","tip":"Build the plans, one worktree each.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js","id":"workers","code":"r2s1","x":200,"about":"Up to 5 at a time, each in its own git worktree. Writes code, tests and the docs its change affects, decides on its own and commits all its work. A worker that gets stuck says why, and that becomes a bug for the next fix round. A plan may name a saved workflow to run instead."},{"y":440,"sub":["one per built task: checks it against plan +","design, runs tests (reuses the worker's if clean);","finds each bug's cause and plans its fix"],"name":"Detective ants","tip":"Check each built task and plan every fix.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js","id":"detectives","code":"r2s2","x":760,"about":"One per task, started as soon as it is built. Checks the work against its plan and architecture.md, and runs the tests. Each bug comes back with how to see it, its cause and a fix plan; a worker builds the fix and the detective re-checks. 3 tries per bug, 3 fix rounds, then the task drops. Never changes code. A dropped task's branch is kept for a later look, tasks built on it drop too, and the final report lists them."},{"y":440,"sub":["merges passing tasks in a scratch","copy, tests once: the combined test;","fewer than 2 passing tasks: no combined test"],"name":"Integrator ant","tip":"Merges all passing tasks in a scratch copy and tests once.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js (Combined phase)","id":"integrator","code":"r2s3","x":1200,"about":"Two tasks can pass alone and break together. It merges every passing task in a straight line in a throwaway copy and runs the tests once. A clashing task takes in the tasks it clashes with and goes back through the fix loop; 2 rounds. Skipped with fewer than 2 passing tasks."},{"y":440,"sub":["merges in a straight line in a scratch copy,","or reuses build's trial merge; then checks","its own merge with git cherry"],"name":"Merger ant","tip":"Merges the approved tasks for real, then checks with git; failures go back to the workers.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Merge phase)","id":"merger","code":"r2s4","x":1460,"about":"Adds every passing task's commits in a straight line, in dependency order, in a scratch copy, and tests once. It reuses build's trial merge when nothing moved. Then it checks its own merge with git cherry and counts changed lines with git diff --shortstat. Never touches main. A conflict, failed tests, or a task git finds missing goes back to the worker ant on its own branch: it merges the current main, fixes the bug, the detective re-checks, the integrator tests again, and finish retries the merge. Tasks that merged cleanly are not rebuilt. At most 2 extra build rounds; what is left drops and is reported."},{"y":440,"sub":["cleans up dead code and mess itself: edits,","runs the tests, commits, lands it only if","they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines;","a cleanup run has no janitor"],"name":"Janitor ant","tip":"Cleans up mess the run left, by itself.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Upkeep phase)","id":"janitor","code":"r2s5","x":1720,"about":"Finds dead code, bloat and duplication from the merged tasks only. In its own worktree it edits, runs the tests and commits, and lands the cleanup only if they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines, and a cleanup run gets no janitor. Tests failing: the cleanup is dropped, main moves with the tasks alone, its branch is kept, and its note goes to the next run's Task, where the investigator may ask about it."},{"y":760,"sub":["one per merged task, 5 at once;","only with 3+ merged tasks"],"name":"Juror ants","tip":"Score each merged task against its plan.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","id":"jurors","code":"r3s1","x":160,"about":"One per merged task, up to 5 at once, only with 3 or more merged tasks. Each scores its task against that task's plan, and the judge weighs their reports."},{"y":760,"sub":["scores the run 0-10: does the code","match the plans? its own call, not an average"],"name":"Judge ant","tip":"Scores the whole run 0-10 against the plans.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","id":"judge","code":"r3s2","x":400,"about":"Reads the investigation report, architecture and every worker plan, and the merged code with the cleanup on top. One question: does the code match the plans? The score is its own call, not an average. 7 or more, or no gaps: main moves. Below 7 with gaps: one fix round."},{"y":850,"sub":["closes the judge's gaps"],"name":"Worker ant","tip":"Closes the judge's gaps.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","id":"judge-fix-worker","code":"r3s3","x":500,"about":"Builds the judge's gaps as one fix on top of the merged scratch copy."},{"y":850,"sub":["checks the fix, runs the tests"],"name":"Detective ant","tip":"Checks the judge fix.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","id":"judge-fix-detective","code":"r3s4","x":660,"about":"Checks the fix and runs the tests. A failed fix keeps its branch and the verdict says why."},{"y":850,"sub":["fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix;","the fix lands only through this fast-forward"],"name":"Merger ant","tip":"Lands the judge fix by fast-forward.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (merger-ant:judge-fix)","id":"judge-fix-merger","code":"r3s5","x":820,"about":"Fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix. The fix lands only through this fast-forward."},{"y":850,"sub":["scores again; still below 7:","main moves, verdict flagged"],"name":"Judge ant","tip":"Scores again after the fix.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","id":"judge-again","code":"r3s6","x":1000,"about":"Scores the run a second time. Still below 7: main moves anyway and the verdict is flagged. The judge never blocks main."},{"y":760,"sub":["fast-forwards main, removes worktrees,","appends the stage rows, runs the check"],"name":"Finisher ant","tip":"Moves main, cleans up, runs the check.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Main phase)","id":"finisher","code":"r3s7","x":1180,"about":"Fast-forwards main, which git refuses if it would overwrite local edits. Removes the worktrees, appends the stage's logbook rows, and runs checkCommand when it is set."},{"y":760,"sub":["fast-forward only,","never pushed"],"name":"MAIN","tip":"Your main branch, moved forward.","src":"SKILL.md#4-finish","id":"main","code":"r3s8","x":1340,"about":"Moves only as a fast-forward, never a merge commit, and is never pushed. Push it yourself when you are happy."},{"y":760,"sub":["the finisher ant builds and checks the app,","only when main moved and checkCommand is set"],"name":"checkCommand","tip":"Builds and checks the app after main moves.","src":"ishikari.py config <state> checkCommand <cmd>","id":"check","code":"r3s9","x":1580,"about":"The finisher ant runs the repo's saved checkCommand, only when main moved and the command is set. A failure starts one check-fix round. The check-fix round is one build round from the moved main, as a new task named check-fix. If the check still fails after it, the run stops and reports the output, and requirements are not marked done."},{"y":760,"sub":["the main session marks the kept :ID:s","once the check passed, or there is none"],"name":"req done","tip":"Marks this run's requirements DONE.","src":"scripts/ishikari.py (req done)","id":"req-done","code":"r3s10","x":1780,"about":"The main session runs ishikari.py req done with the :ID:s kept in planning, once the check passed or there is none. var W=2000,H=1160,svg=document.documentElement,pn=document.getElementById('pn'),box=pn.firstChild; function show(i,px,py){var d=D[i];box.querySelector('b').textContent=d.name; box.querySelector('small').textContent=d.id+(d.code?' \u00b7 '+d.code:''); box.querySelector('p.sum').textContent=(d.sub||[]).join(' ');box.querySelector('p.about').textContent=d.about; box.querySelector('code').textContent=d.src;box.querySelector('code').style.display=d.src?'':'none';pn.classList.add('on'); var ax=px==null?d.x:px,ay=py==null?d.y:py,h=box.offsetHeight||200,x=ax+30,y=ay-20; if(x+420>W-10)x=ax-450;if(x<10)x=10;if(y+h>H-10)y=H-10-h;if(y<10)y=10; pn.setAttribute('x',x);pn.setAttribute('y',y);pn.setAttribute('height',h+4);} function at(e){var p=svg.createSVGPoint();p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;return p.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());} function hide(){pn.classList.remove('on');} document.querySelectorAll('.ck').forEach(function(g){ g.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var p=at(e);show(+g.dataset.i,p.x,p.y);});
